title: Cost-Aware Optimized Front-Door Experimental Design
summary: Causal effect estimation often succeeds cost-constrained sequential data collection. This work considers multivariate linear front-door models with arbitrary unobserved confounding on treatment and response. We optimize the experimental design by balancing the statistical efficiency and measurement costs through partial data. The full-data efficient influence function for the causal effect is derived, together with the geometry of all observed-data influence functions.
